title: Obdolbos
description: Feel the Pain from Escape from Tarkov
body:
The mod adds the **Obdolbos** item from *Escape from Tarkov* and introduces a risk-based survival mechanic. Obdolbos can be used as a stimulant, but each dose triggers one of four effects with an equal 25% chance. Possible outcomes include instant death, slow health depletion, severe weakness, or a short burst of chaotic strength.

The mod is intended for players who want to add unpredictability to gameplay, increase combat tension, and use a unique item that directly influences survival strategy.
